Coca-Cola Cake 🥤🍫 This old-fashioned Coca-Cola Cake is rich, incredibly moist, and covered with a warm chocolate frosting that melts right into the cake. Mini marshmallows bake into the batter, giving this nostalgic 9×13 cake an extra-soft texture. You can get the more detailed version with extra tips, step-by-step help, and a printable recipe on my website. Visit my blog through the link in my bio! For the cake: 2 cups all-purpose flour 2 cups granulated sugar ½ teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 cup Coca-Cola 1 cup salted butter ⅓ cup unsweetened cocoa powder ½ cup buttermilk 2 large eggs 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 cup mini marshmallows For the frosting: ½ cup salted butter 3 Tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder 6 Tablespoons Coca-Cola 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 3¾ cups powdered sugar 1 cup chopped pecans or walnuts, optional Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9×13-inch baking dish. Whisk together the flour, sugar, salt, and baking soda in a large bowl. In a saucepan over medium heat, combine the Coca-Cola, butter, and cocoa powder. Heat until the butter melts and the mixture just begins to simmer, whisking occasionally. Pour the hot cocoa mixture into the dry ingredients and whisk until combined. Add the buttermilk, eggs, and vanilla, stirring just until smooth. Fold in the mini marshmallows. Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish and bake for 30–35 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out with a few moist crumbs. About five minutes before the cake finishes baking, melt the butter with the cocoa powder and Coca-Cola in a saucepan over medium heat. Remove it from the heat and whisk in the vanilla and powdered sugar until smooth. Stir in the nuts, if using. Pour the warm frosting over the warm cake and spread it evenly. Let the frosting set before slicing. #cocacolacake #chocolatecake #southerndessert #oldfashionedrecipes #cakerecipe Coca-Cola cake recipe, old-fashioned Coca-Cola cake, Southern chocolate cake, chocolate sheet cake, 9×13 cake recipe, chocolate cake with warm frosting, nostalgic dessert recipe

VOLCÁN CHOCOLATE 👇receta escrita👇 CLICK @laura.lopez.mon para más recetas fáciles 💥GUÁRDATE💥 esta receta de pastel de chocolate | lava cake, facilísimo de hacer con 5 ingredientes, sin robots ¡nunca falla! ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍 INGREDIENTES 4 unidades 200 g chocolate (mínimo 55% de cacao) 70 g mantequilla 4 huevos M 70 g azúcar 50 g harina trigo común (sin levaduras) Para pincelar los moldes : mantequilla y cacao puro en polvo ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍ELABORACIÓN 🔹️ Pon en un recipiente el chocolate y la mantequilla y fúndelo. Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Brown Butter Chocolate Lava Cakes with Chapman’s Vanilla Trilogy ice cream 🍫🧈 I’ve tested dozens of molten cake recipes, and these are the ones I keep coming back to… rich, gooey, and guaranteed to impress. You can also use muffin pans instead of ramekins! The three decadent moves that make these next-level… 👇 1️⃣ Brown Butter – Adds nutty, toffee-like depth that elevates the chocolate and makes the cakes unforgettable. 2️⃣ Molten Center – Baked just enough to hold shape but still melt like lava when you dig in. 3️⃣ Serve with the best vanilla ice cream you can find – which is why I use @Chapman’s Ice Cream Super Premium Plus Vanilla Trilogy. It’s Canadian-made and ridiculously creamy. Ingredients: -1/2 cup browned unsalted butter -6 ounces semi-sweet chocolate  -2 large eggs, room temperature  -2 large egg yolks, room temperature -1/4 cup granulated sugar  -2 tablespoons all-purpose flour -1/4 tsp salt  -Chapman’s Vanilla Trilogy, for topping   For each ramekin: 1/2 tablespoon cacao powder + 1/2 tablespoon butter *makes 4 larger lava cakes or 6 small ones Instructions: 1. In a saucepan over medium heat, melt ½ cup + 1 tbsp of unsalted butter. (Yes, the extra tablespoon matters — some of it evaporates). Stir constantly: first it’ll melt, then foam, sizzle, and finally, turn a deep golden brown with a rich, nutty smell. The second it hits peak bronze (before it burns!), remove from heat and pour into a bowl. 2. Let your browned butter cool for about 1–2 minutes, then stir in your 6 oz of semi-sweet chocolate (chips or chunks are both cool here). Mix until it’s smooth, glossy, and looks like chocolate ganache’s hotter cousin. Place in the fridge for 5–10 minutes to let it cool down a little more while you prep the rest. 3. Butter and cacao powder are your best friends here. For each ramekin (or muffin well), rub in ½ tbsp of butter, then dust with ½ tbsp cacao powder, making sure to coat evenly. Tip: If using ramekins, set them on a baking sheet for easy oven transfer. 4. In a large bowl, aggressively whisk together: 2 eggs, 2 egg yolks (this is where the richness comes from) 5. Once combined and a bit frothy, add: ¼ cup sugar, 2 tbsp flour, ¼ tsp salt. Whisk until smooth. Then, slowly stream in the cooled chocolate-butter mix while whisking. Keep whisking until you’ve got a smooth, luscious batter. 6. Scoop or pour your batter into the prepared ramekins or muffin tin, filling each one about ¾ full. Bake at 425°F (220°C) for 10–12 minutes. You're aiming for a firm edge and a jiggly center. Don’t overthink it — it’s supposed to look slightly underbaked in the middle. 7. Let cool for 1 minute, then gently flip onto a plate (or serve in the ramekin if you’re going rustic). Top with a scoop of Chapman’s Super Premium Plus Vanilla Trilogy Ice Cream and dig in while the center is still molten and magical. #baking #lavacakes #chocolate #dessert #recipe#homebaker #ad #ChapmansIceCream #Canada #BuyCanadian

Giant Brown Butter Espresso Chocolate Lava Cake Makes 1 x 6” lava cake (perfect for two spoons) Ingredients:      •    100g unsalted butter     •    120g 54% dark chocolate, chopped     •    20g strong espresso or very strong coffee, hot     •    5g freshly ground coffee     •    2 medium eggs     •    2 egg yolks     •    120g caster sugar     •    100g self-raising flour     •    1 tsp vanilla extract     •    Pinch of flaky sea salt     •    Cocoa powder, for dusting the tin Method: 1.     Preheat the oven to 160°C (fan). This batter comes together quickly, so you want the oven ready. 2.    Place the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook until it melts, foams, and the milk solids turn golden brown and smell nutty. Remove from the heat immediately. 3.    Add the chopped dark chocolate, hot coffee, ground coffee, vanilla, and flaky salt to the hot browned butter. Stir until the chocolate is fully melted and smooth. Set aside to cool slightly. 4.    In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs, egg yolks, and caster sugar until pale and slightly thickened. This helps create structure while keeping the centre molten. 5.    Stir the flour into the chocolate mixture until just combined. Gently fold the egg mixture into the chocolate in two additions, keeping as much air as possible. 6.    Grease a 6” round tin and dust generously with cocoa powder, tapping out the excess. 7.    Pour the batter into the prepared tin and bake for 18 minutes. The edges should be set, with a soft, slightly wobbly centre. 8.    Rest for 2–3 minutes before serving. Spoon straight from the tin or carefully turn out.

Le secret du Gâteau Volcan : Moelleux et irrésistible ! 🌋🍫. 1.La base : Battre les œufs avec le sucre et la vanille jusqu’à ce que le mélange blanchisse. 2.Les liquides : Ajouter l’huile tout en continuant de battre, puis verser le lait. 3.Le secret de la texture : Incorporer la farine (environ 300g) petit à petit. Attention : la quantité peut varier selon la qualité de votre farine (certaines absorbent plus que d’autres !). 4.La touche finale : Ajouter le cacao et la levure chimique en même temps que la farine. 5.	Le montage : Verser la pâte dans un moule de 27 cm de diamètre, puis déposer délicatement au centre la crème pâtissière maison. 6.	La cuisson : Enfourner à 180°C pendant 40 minutes. Allumer uniquement le bas au début, puis le haut en fin de cuisson pour dorer. 7.	La déco : Une touche de zeste de citron et du chocolat râpé pour le contraste des saveurs. 🍋🍫 Bon appétit ! ❤️ #GâteauVolcan #CakeChocolat #PatisserieMaison #RecetteFacile

Chocolate Volcano Cake Ingredients: 200g dark chocolate (70%) 150g butter 150g sugar 3 eggs 100g flour 25g cocoa powder 8g vanilla sugar 2g salt 3-4g baking powder (optional, for a fluffier texture) Preparation: Melting Chocolate and Butter Break the chocolate into pieces, mix it with butter, and melt over a double boiler or in the microwave (in short 20-second intervals, stirring in between). Making the Batter In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs with sugar and vanilla sugar until light and fluffy. Pour in the melted chocolate and butter mixture, then stir well. Sift in the flour, cocoa powder, salt, and baking powder (if using). Mix gently. Baking Preheat the oven to 170°C. Pour the batter into a 20cm round cake tin lined with parchment paper. Bake for 20-25 minutes. The cake should remain slightly moist inside (check with a toothpick—it should come out slightly sticky). Cooling and Serving Let the cake cool completely in the tin. Optionally, dust with powdered sugar or serve with a scoop of ice cream and caramel. Enjoy! 🍫🎂 #cake #easyrecipe #cupcakes #foodlover #brownies #chocolate #dessert #foodtok #fyp #cookie

🚨 SAVE THIS ONE! 🚨 The easiest 3 INGREDIENT LAVA CAKE and it’s dangerously good 🤤 You need: 🍫 1 box chocolate cake mix 🥤 1 can (12 oz) soda 🍫 1 tub chocolate frosting Mix the cake mix and soda right in your Deep Covered Baker aka the MAGIC POT. Drop spoonfuls of chocolate frosting all over the top. Microwave on HIGH for about 9 to 10 minutes. Let it sit for about 5 minutes and THAT’S IT. 🌋🍫 VOLCÁN DE CHOCOLATE FIT EN 5 MINUTOS EN AIRFRYER (¡Solo 4 ingredientes!) ¿Creías que para comer un volcán de chocolate derretido tenías que salir a un restaurante o romper la dieta? 🤤✨ Esta versión saludable se prepara en solo 5 minutos, no lleva harinas ni azúcares refinados y tiene un corazón de chocolate líquido irresistible. ¡GUARDA ESTA RECETA para tu próximo antojo dulce! 📌 🛒 INGREDIENTES (Para 3 volcanes): 🍎 1 manzana (da dulzor natural y una textura suave increible) 🥚 1 huevo 🍫 50 g de cacao amargo en polvo 🍯 (Opcional): 1 cdita. de tu edulcorante favorito 🍫 3 cuadrados de chocolate sin azúcar (para el centro líquido) 👩‍🍳 PASO A PASO: 1️⃣ Licúa o procesa la manzana, el huevo, el cacao amargo y el edulcorante hasta obtener una mezcla cremosa y homogénea. 2️⃣ Vierte la mezcla en moldes aceitados (o de silicona) hasta llenar la mitad y coloca un cuadrado de chocolate en el centro de cada uno. 3️⃣ Cubre con un poco más de mezcla. 4️⃣ COCCIÓN: 🌬️ Airfryer: 180 °C durante 5 a 6 minutos. ♨️ Horno: 180 °C durante 10 a 12 minutos. ⚡ Microondas (en taza): Potencia máxima por 1 minuto, y luego 1 o 2 tandas de 30 segundos. 5️⃣ Deja reposar 1 minuto, desmolda con cuidado y termina con un poco de cacao espolvoreado por encima. ¡Y a disfrutar! 🎉 💡 TIP EXTRA: ¡Puedes dejar los moldes listos en la heladera y cocinarlos justo unos minutos antes de servir! 🥗 ¿QUIERES MÁS RECETAS SALUDABLES COMO ESTA? 🚨 Te invito a adquirir nuestro recetario fitness en el link de mi perfil. 🥗 ¡Descubre cientos de postres sin culpa, cenas rápidas y desayunos proteicos para cumplir tus metas comiendo increíble! 📲💥 #VolcanDeChocolate #CoulantFit #PostresSaludables #RecetasFitness #RecetasAirfryer
